```artifact
Feature: Login Functionality

Scenario Outline: Successful Login for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
  When a user with valid credentials logs in
  Then they should be granted access to their respective dashboard

Examples:
  | User Type | Credentials | Expected Result |
  | Doctor    | valid       | access to Doctor dashboard |
  | Chemist   | valid       | access to Chemist dashboard |
  | Lab      | valid       | access to Lab dashboard |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful Login due to Incorrect Credentials

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
  When a user with invalid credentials logs in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Credentials | Expected Result |
  | Doctor    | invalid     | denied access |
  | Chemist   | invalid     | denied access |
  | Lab      | invalid     | denied access |

Scenario Outline: Unsuccessful Login due to Missing Credentials

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
  When a user without credentials logs in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Credentials | Expected Result |
  | Doctor    | missing     | denied access |
  | Chemist   | missing     | denied access |
  | Lab      | missing     | denied access |

Scenario Outline: Login with Expired Credentials

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
  When a user with expired credentials logs in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Credentials | Expected Result |
  | Doctor    | expired     | denied access |
  | Chemist   | expired     | denied access |
  | Lab      | expired     | denied access |

Scenario Outline: Login with Locked Account

  Given the system has been set up by an Admin with default passwords for Doctor, Chemists, and Labs
  When a user with locked account logs in
  Then they should be denied access

Examples:
  | User Type | Credentials | Expected Result |
  | Doctor    | locked     | denied access |
  | Chemist   | locked     | denied access |
  | Lab      | locked     | denied access |

```
